newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing prices.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing prices.

text.p: Swiss bond prices ended lower, consolidating after a rally in the long end of the market last week which took yields to year's lows.

In stocks, the Swiss Market Index of leading shares set a record high late in the session. But traders said there was no evidence seen on Monday that investors were shifting funds from bonds into stocks.
One Swiss bond trader said there no real selling pressure in bonds on Monday.
"After gains last week, it is a typical consolidation phase," the trader said.
